scope: Secondary development-only transfer study. Tests the frozen-weight depth effect outside graph routing and 77-intent classification. Does not replace or select any confirmatory method.
input_order: Sort by SHA256 of UTF-8 'inventory-order-v1:' plus the opaque row ID, tie break by ID. Across every method use exactly the same order.
hardware: Reverse the previous physical lane assignment for this entire view. Measure independent one-pass parity on both newly assigned slots before recurrent comparisons. Compare costs within each payload; swapping nodes across datasets alone cannot identify a hardware effect.

analysis.primary: Compare two-pass naive to one ordinary pass in each payload and each native task. Compare to the same-payload zero-extra implementation for measured cost. Deeper endpoints are secondary sensitivity measures.
analysis.full_precision: Report argmax accuracy, summed Brier, NLL, ECE15, risk-coverage, and confident error counts on the full legal distribution per task.
analysis.native: Report qev typed choice accuracy, binary p_yes accuracy at >=0.5 plus binary Brier and log loss, and the ordinal expected-score MAE, RMSE and ranked probability score on the ordered scale 0 through 3. Do not reinterpret the native ordinal expectation as a declared categorical choice.
analysis.paired_nuisance: Within a group report top-answer agreement in canonical answer semantics across the two state/menu renderings. Keep ties, native ambiguity and seed/difficulty supports visible.
